ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and distal lobe regions consist of high-intensity white contiguous fields. These are bordered by low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing edge and the central peduncle area. A distinct transition zone of fine black stippling is mapped between the white fields and the black borders.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately calculated at 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary with irregular jagged peaks and shallow valleys, particularly pronounced on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves extending from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, localized clusters of brownish/tan circular pixel groups (barnacle colonies) concentrated exclusively on the lateral-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; multiple small, dark focal spots scattered across the white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific 'salt-and-pepper' stippling pattern at the interface of the white and black pigmented regions provides a unique visual identifier.
